note: Household notes written by the family, in their own words, for whoever is doing the job. The house hands these back exactly as written. It does not write them, change them, or add advice of its own.

notes: Mia waits at the side gate, not the front.
Tuesdays Timmy has soccer. His boots are in the hall closet.
Snacks are in the blue tin. One each, then homework.
Recycling is the blue bin, out Tuesday night. The lid has to close or they skip it.
Bring them back in on Wednesday after work.
Pots go by hand. Tablets are under the sink.
